title: Pairly HQ
text:
<callout icon="👋" color="blue_bg">
	Welcome to the Pairly team wiki. **Pairly** matches university students into small study groups based on shared courses, free time, and study style.
</callout>
## Where we are
- Public beta launches at **Westbrook University** on <mention-date start="2026-11-02"/>
- App store submission (Android and iOS): <mention-date start="2026-10-25"/>
- Next campuses: Lakeside College (January) and Crestview State (March)
## Team
- **Maya Chen** - Co-founder & CEO
- **Daniel Ortiz** - CTO (pairly-api)
- **Priya Raman** - Product Designer
- **Sam Okafor** - Mobile Developer (pairly-mobile)
- **Wop testwell** - Project Manager (pairly-website, launch checklist, weekly sync notes)
- **Tomas Rivera** - Campus Ambassador, Westbrook University
## Code
All code lives on GitHub under rosenthal-dashboard-test: pairly-api, pairly-mobile, and pairly-website.
